source.original_publication: Projection after original scoring. All planned attempts and original scored rows retained; arbitrary strings, source events, inventory, absolute paths, logs and databases omitted. Fixture paths are templated; out-of-scope paths redacted. Full raw evidence remains private. Null means unavailable.

publication: Compact archive of the original public ETW matrix. All 18 attempts, original scalar measurements, score summaries, gate results, build/executable/scorer/script/measurement hashes and provenance retained. Individual truth/scored rows omitted after counting and canonical hashing; hashes of those arrays use UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=True, and are not the original raw-file hashes. No rescoring, interval adjustment, sample deletion or threshold change.
measurement: Group median/minimum/maximum includes every available sample, including failed attempts; samples records unavailable values. Parent-process CPU/memory/logical I/O measured with Windows APIs; this excludes child/kernel work and does not establish physical-disk I/O. Do not interpret lower elapsed/CPU/I/O in lossy runs as same-workload efficiency. Precise fixture metrics are ratios of original scorer counters only. Event-loss percentage is null because a compatible denominator is unverified. File/process providers are active; registry was not requested. This synthetic fixture does not validate third-party installers or final snapshot ownership.
diagnosis_scope: Source events are absent from the published matrix. Loss is established only by recorded ETW/application counters; an unobserved oracle row alone does not prove a dropped event or a clock mismatch. Other CI runs' strict interval mismatch diagnostics are separate evidence and cannot explain this matrix retrospectively.
